title: Ask to Doc
subtitle: AI-Powered PDF Assistant
description: Built this because I was sick of Ctrl+F-ing through 50-page PDFs. Upload a document, ask it questions in plain English, get actual answers. Took about a month to build, mass amount of coffee, and one mass late nights.
features: Upload any PDF and chat with it naturally
Actually understands context, not just keyword matching
Free tier + Pro with PayPal subscriptions
techHighlights: Next.js 14 - because I like fast sites
Convex for real-time stuff without the headache
LangChain doing the AI heavy lifting
Clerk saved me weeks on auth
PayPal for payments (international users love it)
cardDescription: Got tired of Ctrl+F through long PDFs. So I built an AI that actually reads and answers questions from your documents.

title: AI Trip Planner
subtitle: Smart Travel Assistant
description: Planning trips was eating up my weekends. This app takes your destination and builds a full itinerary—hotels, places to visit, restaurants. Not perfect yet, but it works better than spending hours on Google.
features: Tell it where you're going, get a full itinerary
Real places from Google Places API (not made up stuff)
Google login so you don't need another password
Save trips and share with friends
techHighlights: React frontend - nothing fancy, just works
Firebase because I didn't want to manage servers
Google Places API for actual venue data
Could use some polish but ships working
cardDescription: Planning trips took forever. Built this to generate full itineraries with real hotel and restaurant suggestions. Still improving it.

title: NASA Bioscience Knowledge Engine
subtitle: AI-Powered Research Search
description: A hackathon project that turned into something real. Ask questions about NASA's bioscience research in plain English, get answers with actual citations. Nerdy? Yes. Cool? Also yes.
features: Search NASA research without reading 100 papers
AI answers with cited sources (not hallucinations)
Semantic search - actually understands what you mean
Built for researchers but anyone can use it
techHighlights: Gemini 2.0 Flash - fast and smart enough
LangChain RAG pipeline for accurate retrieval
Still adding more papers to the database
cardDescription: Hackathon project that grew up. Search NASA bioscience research with plain English questions. Gets you answers with real citations.
